purpose: Check of the unconfirmed-receipt correction of 2026-11-12.
provenance: Written on 2026-11-12 after the correction and before any generation with it.
reviewPolicy: The answer must say the sender can still replace an unconfirmed payment and advise waiting for a confirmation.

conversations.purpose: Recipient of an unconfirmed payment: can the sender still change it, and when to deliver.

turns.question: Someone paid me with an unconfirmed transaction. Can the sender still change what I receive?
mustCover: Yes, until confirmation the sender can replace the transaction
Wait for a confirmation before treating it as paid
mustNotClaim: The outputs are fixed while unconfirmed

turns.question: So when is it safe to hand over the goods?
mustCover: After at least one confirmation, more for larger amounts
mustNotClaim: It is safe as soon as the payment appears

conversations.purpose: Recipient of an unconfirmed payment: can the sender still change it, and when to deliver.

turns.question: Un client m'a payé mais la transaction n'est pas encore confirmée. Peut-il encore annuler le paiement ?
mustCover: Oui, tant qu'elle n'est pas confirmée l'expéditeur peut la remplacer
mustNotClaim: Le paiement est définitif dès qu'il apparaît

turns.question: Donc à partir de quand je peux livrer ?
mustCover: Après au moins 1 confirmation, davantage pour un gros montant
